items.title: Meet Martini: A Film Set for AI Video That Aims to Help Filmmakers Streamline Their Shots
items.excerpt: Martini is a collaborative, web-based platform pitched as a 'film set' for AI video: filmmakers upload or generate their own sets and reference images, then compose shots in 2D or 3D environments to escape prompt roulette and give crews a shared pre-production hub. Out now with a free indie tier and paid plans from $15/month.

items.title: Netflix says it's already used AI in 'roughly 300' titles this year
items.excerpt: Netflix disclosed that generative-AI workflows have been folded into roughly 300 of its 2026 titles, with the heaviest concentration in post-production, framing the tools as a way to hit results faster and cheaper than conventional VFX and finishing work.

items.title: Foundry's SmartRoto: AI-assisted roto that aims to work the way you do
items.excerpt: Foundry unveiled SmartRoto, an AI-powered Nuke plugin that speeds rotoscoping by automatically propagating keyframes while keeping artists in creative control through a 'smart keys' and 'user keys' system, targeting one of VFX's most tedious manual bottlenecks.

items.title: SwitchHDR, an AI model for HDR reconstruction from SDR video
items.excerpt: Beeble's SwitchHDR is a machine-learning model that reconstructs HDR imagery from ordinary SDR video for professional post, addressing the reality that most existing footage is SDR while productions increasingly demand HDR-quality assets.

items.title: Tilly Norwood creator developing feature film 'Misaligned' starring the AI actor
items.excerpt: Particle 6, the UK company behind AI-generated 'actor' Tilly Norwood, is developing its first feature, the comedy-drama 'Misaligned,' using a hybrid production model that pairs traditional filmmaking roles with AI specialists — a concrete test of how synthetic-performer pipelines reshape a production.
